newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-JULIAN IN DOUBT FOR OVAL TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-JULIAN IN DOUBT FOR OVAL TEST.

text.p: Australia's build-up to next week's sixth and final test against England hit another setback when all-rounder Brendon Julian withdrew from Thursday's one-day game against Ireland with a fractured wrist.
Julian, who has not played in the Ashes series, was poised to return to the side following Jason Gillespie's back injury and Paul Reiffel's decision to return to Australia for domestic reasons.
"Brendon got hit on the wrist by a net bowler seven days ago," said Australian coach Geoff Marsh. "We took him to the hospital and there's a slight crack in the wrist."
The Australians will not make a decision about calling up a replacement until they return to London on Friday.
Australia have already retained the Ashes and lead the series 3-1.
